note: Fan-shaped loops among willows above Chain Lakes Reservoir, 38 km southwest of Nanton on Hwy 533; a short walk to the water's edge. No fire pits at the sites: communal fire pits in each loop with free firewood, and propane fire pits only next to or inside those. Boat launch, pier, cook shelter and playground at the day-use area. Tap water runs from the May long weekend to the September long weekend, weather permitting. Not to be confused with Chain Lakes Provincial Recreation Area near Athabasca. --Claude
